user_questions.question: What counts as 'no price'? Options: (a) Price__c is blank only; (b) blank or $0.00. Evidence: Menu_Item__c.Price__c is an optional Currency field with no default; today 0 of 206 items are blank and 0 are $0.00; AgentCreateMenuWithItemsActions can insert items with a blank price. Recommendation: (a) blank only, so intentionally free items stay orderable.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Blank only: Menu Items where Price is null and Available = true should be set to Available = false.
